visual_enhancers.terminal_header: High-density ticker bar at top with real-time green/red gain indicators and market indices (S&P 500, NASDAQ, BTC, ETH, GOLD, 10Y BOND)
visual_enhancers.grid_borders: 1px solid #222C3D clean terminal grid separation with sharp/minimal radius rounded-sm or rounded-none
visual_enhancers.badges: Sharp rectangular or pill badges with high-contrast text and low-opacity color tint (e.g., bg-emerald-950/80 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-800/50)
visual_enhancers.data_density: Tight padding (px-3 py-2 for tables, p-3 for metric widgets) to maximize scanability without clutter

grids.dashboard_mode: MODE B: High Density Grid (Terminal Data Correlation)

layouts.structure: Fixed dark terminal bar -> Main Navigation Header -> 4 Tab Views -> Sticky live ticker status bar / summary footer
layouts.tab_1_portfolio: Robinhood CSV import trigger + Portfolio summary metrics (Total Value, Daily P/L, Total P/L, Cash) + Holdings table (Stocks & Crypto with filter) + Asset Allocation chart + Performance sparklines
layouts.tab_2_stock_news: Filterable news timeline auto-matched to held tickers (AAPL, NVDA, TSLA, BTC, etc.) with sentiment tags and AI summary breakdown
layouts.tab_3_macro_news: Macro intelligence monitor covering Tariffs, Central Banks/Fed rates, Bond yields, Gold/Oil commodities, and Geopolitics with market impact badges
layouts.tab_4_sentiment: Bullish vs Bearish market sentiment dashboard with gauge meters, Social sentiment index (Reddit/X sentiment), fear & greed gauge, and stock-by-stock breakdown

motion.transitions: Fast, crisp micro-interactions: transition: color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease
motion.ticker_pulse: Subtle emerald/red highlight pulse when prices refresh
motion.tab_switch: Instant tab render with quick opacity fade-in (100ms)

accessibility.contrast: APCA & WCAG AA compliant contrast ratio (> 4.5:1 for numeric values on dark surfaces)
accessibility.data_testids: All interactive buttons, tab selectors, CSV file inputs, filter pills, and search boxes MUST have descriptive data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='tab-portfolio-button', data-testid='robinhood-csv-upload-input', data-testid='stock-news-filter-select')
accessibility.keyboard_nav: Full keyboard access for tab switching and table row selection

media.icons: Lucide React icons with 16px to 20px size for compact technical visual markers

3d_libraries.charts: Recharts / Shadcn charts with dark theme customizations (#10B981 for gain, #EF4444 for loss, #F59E0B for amber alerts)
3d_libraries.gauge_meters: Custom SVG semi-circle gauges for sentiment (Bullish/Bearish ratio)

image_urls.description: Candlestick dark trading chart background overlay
Crypto market analytics dark monitor screen

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a Bloomberg Terminal inspired investment management dashboard with dark theme (#0A0D12 base background, #121721 panels, amber #F59E0B accents, green #10B981 gain, red #EF4444 loss).

Implement the 4 mandatory tabs: 1. Portfolio (Stocks + Crypto, Robinhood CSV import, P/L, table, charts), 2. Stock News (filtered to user's held symbols), 3. Macro News (Tariffs, Fed rates, Bonds, Gold, Geopolitics), 4. Public Sentiment (Bull/Bear gauges, social sentiment summary per stock).

Provide CSV file import functionality supporting Robinhood export format (Symbol, Description, Quantity, Average Cost, Last Price, Value) as well as manual stock/crypto addition and pre-loaded sample Robinhood portfolio data.
Use monospace font for all prices, percentages, quantities, P/L metrics, and stock symbols to give an authentic trading terminal feel.
Ensure tables have sortable columns, search/filter inputs, tight padding, and clear left-aligned structure.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never use full-screen bright gradients on dark themes.
Do not center-align the app container. Maintain left-aligned, structured data density.
Avoid generic centered layouts; use structured grids with high information density.
Always set explicit hover text colors (e.g. hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white).
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes in kebab-case.
